changelog:
• 🧲 Native BitTorrent P2P Engine: Restored native libtorrent4j + NanoHTTPD local streaming server for direct magnet streaming without PikPak errors
• 📊 Real-time P2P Buffering HUD: Dynamic streaming dialog displaying live download speed, peer count, seed count, and progress bar
• 🎬 Seamless Video Transitions: Preserved persistent background trailer player between Home and Details screens with smooth container animation
• 🇮🇳 Instant Trailer Switching: Direct in-place player controls for both Official and Hindi trailers with immediate playback
• 📐 Refined Trailer Layout: Fitted top-right trailer container on Home screen to eliminate top cropping and excessive stretching
• ⚡ Compact Card Actions: Replaced action button labels with clean PP ☁ badge and removed external player button
• 🛡️ 5.8 GB Cloud Quota Guard: Restricted direct PikPak action button to files under 5.8 GB to prevent cloud quota limits
• ↻ Clean Restart Action: Reload button now restarts P2P streams from the beginning ignoring saved position
